summary: This Form 8-K reports that at its May 20, 2026 annual meeting, American Tower Corporation stockholders approved the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, a compensatory arrangement granting equity-based awards to employees. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, liquidation, or other special situation. The filing is a routine current report regarding board-approved equity plan adoption and shareholder vote, not a forced management departure or strategic transaction. No deal terms apply.
